title: State Variable Shadowing in Factory Contracts Causes Incorrect Fee Application
summary: The client has marked a bug as "Fixed" in the code. The issue was found in two files, `TokenVestingManagerFactory.sol` and `NativeTokenVestingManagerFactory.sol`. Both of these files have their own version of a mapping called `_customFees`, which causes problems because they are supposed to inherit this mapping from another contract called `FactoryFeeManager`. This results in two separate storage slots being used for the same purpose. As a result, the custom fee logic does not work correctly and the functions `newNativeTokenVestingManager()` and `newTokenVestingManager()` do not use the intended fees. To fix this, the shadowed mappings should be removed from the two affected files and the visibility of the mapping in `FactoryFeeManager` should be set to `internal`.
